history.recommendation_text: The Board recommended that the Administration ensure that a clear legal framework is in place for staff between the entities of the United Nations as reported in volume I and the United Nations Development Programme (UNDP).
history.administration_response: As regards the recommendation on the legal framework, as clarified earlier, the Office for the Coordination of Humanitarian Affairs is not the lead in the implementation of the recommendation regarding the review of the overarching legal framework which governs the memorandums of understanding/service- level agreements of all Secretariat entities, including that of the Office for the Coordination of Humanitarian Affairs with UNDP. The Office will contribute to these discussions together with other entities, as and when the discussions take place. As regards the amendments to the letters of appointment, UNDP has already started issuing the amended letter of offer/appointment to all new hires effective 15 May 2023 for all National Professional Officers and General Service staff in the field administered by UNDP with services limited to the Office. Discussions are ongoing on how these changes will be reflected in letters of appointment issued prior to 15 May 2023. UNDP is working on a proposal and schedule for implementing these changes.
history.board_assessment: Given that the amendments to the letter of appointment have not taken effect, the Board considers this recommendation to be under implementation.
